about_the_game:
You are just a janitor in a not-so-ordinary hotel.
At first glance, your job seems simple: dusting, washing laundry, picking up trash, and keeping dozens of rooms tidy. But the higher you climb the floors, the clearer it becomes — this is no ordinary hotel.

Every room tells its own story.
Here, someone threw a wild party and left piles of dirty clothes, bottles, and footprints on the carpet. There, a luxurious presidential suite hides expensive furniture and even more expensive secrets. In the utility rooms, pipes rumble and warning lights flicker, and up on the rooftop… you may stumble upon something forbidden.

🕵️ The Dark Secrets of the Hotel

Your mission is to keep everything clean. But the longer you work, the more often you come across things you were never meant to see:

📸 provocative photographs
📹 strange videos left behind by guests
💌 personal items hinting at secret rendezvous
🕶️ clues that piece together into a hidden story

You never know what lies behind the next door.

🎮 Gameplay Features

  • Cleaning simulator — pick up trash, wash clothes, wipe stains, mop floors.

  • Unexpected discoveries — photos, videos, and items reveal the hidden lives of hotel guests.

  • Varied locations — from simple corridors and standard rooms to the restaurant, SPA, and the presidential suite.

  • Cozy yet trashy vibe — a cartoonish art style inspired by animated series clashes with the “dirty” secrets you uncover.

  • Storytelling through details — the narrative unfolds gradually through the objects you find and the atmosphere around you.

✨ Why Play?

This isn’t just about cleaning. It’s a game about curiosity, humor, and secrets. Every rag, stain, and piece of trash can lead to a new discovery. And maybe — just maybe — you’ll uncover what was meant to stay hidden behind the closed doors of the Sin Hotel.

content_descriptors.notes:
Sin Hotel contains content not suitable for all ages or for viewing at work:
Sexual themes — the player may find photographs and videos of a sexual nature (no explicit sex acts shown).
Nudity — some images include partial or full nudity.
Sexual humor — certain discoveries are comedic but contain mature themes.
Alcohol and smoking — bottles, cigarettes, and party trash can be found.
This game does not include:
sexual assault or non-consensual sex,
drug use,
self-harm or suicide.
